source_review.notes: Checked all 11 structured references against current official W3C, dbt Labs, Apache Iceberg/Avro, Protocol Buffers, Google AIP, IETF RFC Editor, OpenLineage, and Semantic Versioning sources; every final URL returned HTTP 200. Verified scoped claims about dataset version relationships, model coexistence/deprecation, field identity and schema resolution, compatibility/versioning guidance, deprecation versus sunset signaling, lineage version facets, and semantic-version prerequisites. Tool-specific structural rules are never treated as universal semantic compatibility.

evidence: Checked consumer-valid-use/observation compatibility quantification, retirement conjunction, qualified compatibility relation, identity receipt tuple, inventory union/coverage vector, lifecycle inequalities, and dual-production comparison classes plus balanced GitHub math delimiters.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation separates product, contract, state, implementation, schema, distribution and alias identities; compatibility is directional and scoped, with unknown retained as a first-class outcome.

evidence: Executed dataset-retirement-gate and matched four consumers, two migrated, one recently active old consumer, one ownerless consumer, reached sunset, denied retirement, and the two named blockers.
Recomputed the exercise quiet-window boundary: last old use on day 94 satisfies a 30-day interval no earlier than day 124.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Counts and date arithmetic are correct under the fixture; the chapter explicitly states that hidden consumers, replacement readiness, preservation, approval, and telemetry coverage are outside the computation.

evidence: Verified the universally quantified compatibility definition over old valid uses and consumer-specific observational equivalence.
Verified that one false conjunct, KnownMigrated, makes the evidence-gated retirement predicate false even after sunset.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The formalization is correctly framed as a specification model rather than an automatically decidable universal compatibility algorithm.

evidence: Reviewed additive columns with SELECT-star/allowlist consumers, type widening and overflow, stable-ID renames with name-bound tools, same-type unit changes, population and freshness changes, strict enums/defaults, field reuse, seasonal and offline consumers, expired telemetry, and unknown ownership.

Reviewed premature announcement, divergent dual production, adapter non-equivalence, forced break, indefinite exception, recovery of retired aliases, audit preservation, personal-data deletion, and eventual physical disposition.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Adversarial coverage spans structure, semantics, time, quality, access, delivery, production, discovery, migration, retirement, preservation and disaster recovery.

evidence: Traced separated identities, whole-contract diffs, scoped compatibility, immutable records, ready replacement, old/new reconciliation, multi-source inventory, explicit lifecycle states, evidence-gated retirement and preservation/deletion through examples and answers.
invariant_checking.notes: No schema checker, suffix, version number, Git commit, latest alias, notice email, quiet log, migration percentage, query success, sunset date or retained snapshot is treated as broader evidence than it provides.

evidence: Reviewed the same-integer-type dollars-to-cents counterexample establishing that structural readability is insufficient for semantic compatibility.
Reviewed the active critical export counterexample establishing that a reached sunset date is insufficient for evidence-gated retirement.
proof_review.notes: Both counterexamples establish precisely the claimed non-implications and preserve the legitimate role of structural checks, dates, and explicit forced-break risk acceptance.

evidence: Both theorem-like sections are explicitly labeled conditional claims and proofs by counterexample with scope limitations.
The executable is labeled deterministic evidence accounting and disclaims discovery, telemetry coverage, semantics, and approval.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Formal implications, deterministic computation, registry/tool behavior, empirical telemetry, domain review and governance approval remain distinct evidence categories.

evidence: Current standards and tool behavior are attributed to named primary sources and scoped to their documented interfaces.
Consumer inventory, quiet windows, dual-run diffs, usage coverage, backfills, SLOs, canaries and migration acceptance are framed as bounded evidence with explicit blind spots.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: The chapter distinguishes unobserved from unused, schema compatibility from contract compatibility, calendar state from retirement readiness, and retained evidence from continued service.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed end to end. The chapter coherently separates version identities, expands contracts beyond schema, defines scoped compatibility, chooses change strategies, builds replacements, discovers consumers, governs coexistence and alias movement, and separates deprecation, sunset, retirement, preservation and deletion.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed the version record, falsifiable migration claim, twelve-step mechanism, typed change inventory, consumer evidence model, communications, exception rules, retirement gates, estate metrics, ten examples and five operational answers for actionable use.

pedagogical_review.notes: Reviewed progression from one-page distinction through identity, contract, change classification, strategy choice, replacement readiness, consumer discovery, migration contract, coexistence, lifecycle gates, preservation and portfolio governance; notation, two counterexamples, executable gate, 14 trade-offs, 33 misconceptions, ten examples and five complete answers reinforce the governing question. Connections accurately retrieve DE-039/049-050/064/066/070/073/076-077/082-083/088-089/094/098, API-081-085 and PLAT-085 and prepare DE-100.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
